assumptions.condition: The row dimension \(r\) is fixed independently of \(n\).
The real-weight law \(D_{\mathbb R}\) satisfies \(\mathbb E_{D_{\mathbb R}}[z]=m\).
The rational-weight law \(D_{\mathbb Q}\) satisfies \(\mathbb E_{D_{\mathbb Q}}[z]=m\).

standard.name: rational point of a rational marginal polytope

assumptions.condition: The total flow leaving the root \((0,0)\) equals one.
At every internal node of \(G\), inflow equals outflow.

standard.name: exact coupling marginals in flow form
linear outcome model over prespecified balance features

definitions.name: \(S_i\) and \(G\)
definitions.construction: \(S_0=\{0\}\), \(S_i=\{s+\sigma a_i:s\in S_{i-1},\ \sigma\in\{-1,1\}\}\) for \(i=1,\ldots,n\), and \(G\) contains the labeled arc \((i,s,\sigma):(i-1,s)\to(i,s+\sigma a_i)\), retaining both labels when \(a_i=0\).

definitions.name: \(\mathcal F_{\mathbb R}(A,p)\)
definitions.construction: \(\{f_{\mathbb R}\in\mathbb R^{E(G)}:f_{\mathbb R}\text{ is nonnegative, has unit root flow, is conserved at internal nodes, and }\sum_{s\in S_{i-1}}f_{\mathbb R,i,s,+1}=p_i\text{ for }i=1,\ldots,n\}\)

definitions.name: \(\mathsf{Cert}_{\mathrm{alg}}\)
definitions.construction: A tuple \((f,U,H,\alpha,V,L)\) encoded over one ordered real-algebraic number field, with \(f\in\mathcal F_{\mathbb R}(A,p)\), \(H\succeq0\), \(\operatorname{tr}(H)=1\), \(UI-C(f)\succeq0\), \(V_{n,s}\le y_s^{\mathsf T}Hy_s\), \(V_{i-1,s}\le V_{i,s+\sigma a_i}-\alpha_i\mathbf 1\{\sigma=+1\}\), and \(U=L=V_{0,0}+\alpha^{\mathsf T}p\).

definitions.name: \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\)
definitions.construction: A rational tuple \((f,U,H,\alpha,V,L)\) with \(f\in\mathcal F_{\mathbb Q}(A,p)\), \(H\succeq0\), \(\operatorname{tr}(H)=1\), \(UI-C(f)\succeq0\), the same terminal and Bellman inequalities as \(\mathsf{Cert}_{\mathrm{alg}}\), \(L=V_{0,0}+\alpha^{\mathsf T}p\), and \(U-L\le2^{-b}\).

definitions.name: \(\mathsf{PrefixCert}\)
definitions.construction: Delete deterministic coordinates and handle \(B=0\) exactly. Construct \(G\) and the independent rational flow. Optimize the boxed assignment dual in variables \((H,\alpha,\beta)\) with \(H\succeq0\) and \(\operatorname{tr}(H)=1\); separate a candidate by rational positive-semidefinite elimination and by the backward recurrence \(V_{n,s}=y_s^{\mathsf T}Hy_s\), \(V_{i-1,s}=\min_{\sigma\in\{-1,1\}}\{V_{i,s+\sigma a_i}-\alpha_i\mathbf 1\{\sigma=+1\}\}\). Recover a rational primal flow from the recorded paths and the independent flow, impose the flow equalities in an exact rational affine parameterization, and apply convex mixing and positive-semidefinite shifting until the exact checker accepts \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\). Decompose the repaired acyclic flow into at most \(E_{\mathrm{lat}}\) positive root-to-terminal paths and output their assignments and rational path weights as the finite-support law.

definitions.name: output-sensitive prefix-certificate handle
definitions.construction: Replace the full-state backward pass inside \(\mathsf{PrefixCert}\) by bidirectional admissible-potential search on reachable states, retaining exact rational reduced-cost inequalities on the explored frontier and a symbolic interval bound for every unexpanded layer box; the target object is a valid \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\) whose work scales with the explored states rather than \(N_{\mathrm{lat}}\).

definitions.name: \(\mathcal R_D(B)\)
definitions.construction: Under fixed potential outcomes and the proposal-maintained consumer conditions \(\mu=B^{\mathsf T}\theta\) and \(\|\theta\|_2\le1\), the known identity in Rao--Zhang Eq. (3) specializes to \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{HT}}-\tau_N=(2n)^{-1}\mu^{\mathsf T}(z-m)\) and \(\mathcal R_D(B)=\lambda_{\max}(C_D)/(4n^2)=\Phi(D)/(4n^2)\).

definitions.name: \(\iota(B)\)
definitions.construction: Append \(\max\{r,n\}-r\) zero rows to \(B\). The definitional identity \(\operatorname{Cov}(\iota(B)z)=\operatorname{diag}(\operatorname{Cov}(Bz),0)\) preserves the nonzero spectrum and the spectral objective for every law. Pass \(\iota(B)\) and \(m\) to the pinned released pure-balance sampler, and audit returned assignments against certificates computed on the original \(r\)-row lattice; padding cost and source failures are reported as implementation outcomes.

definitions.name: \(D_{\mathrm{rep}}\)
definitions.construction: After deleting deterministic target coordinates, set \(\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}=\max_i\{(\widehat p_i-p_i)/\widehat p_i\text{ if }\widehat p_i>p_i,\ (p_i-\widehat p_i)/(1-\widehat p_i)\text{ if }\widehat p_i<p_i,\ 0\text{ otherwise}\}\), set \(q_i^{\mathrm{rep}}=\{p_i-(1-\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}})\widehat p_i\}/\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}\) when \(\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}>0\), and set \(D_{\mathrm{rep}}=(1-\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}})\widehat D+\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}\bigotimes_i\operatorname{Bernoulli}(q_i^{\mathrm{rep}})\), with \(D_{\mathrm{rep}}=\widehat D\) when \(\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}=0\).

definitions.name: \(\mathsf{Bench}\)
definitions.construction: Run four prespecified cells: the rational two-row irrational-optimum instance at gap \(2^{-12}\), a zero-column instance, a nondegenerate thin full-row-rank instance through \(\iota(B)\) with the pinned source unchanged, and the exact zero-matrix branch. For every successful released-code cell, form \(D_{\mathrm{rep}}\); verify exact marginals and covariance; report the same Bellman lower value against the lattice design, repaired baseline, and independent Bernoulli law; record source failures, padding dimensions, repair mass, support size, expanded-lattice size, time, and memory without asserting performance superiority.

statements.statement: For every finite \(n\) and \(r\), the image of \(\mathfrak D_{\mathbb R}(p)\) under \(D\mapsto C_D\) equals \(\mathcal K_{\mathbb R}(A,\gamma,p)\), and the image of \(\mathfrak D_{\mathbb Q}(p)\) equals \(\mathcal K_{\mathbb Q}(A,\gamma,p)\). Pushing a law to labeled arc occupations and disintegrating a flow preserve every coordinate marginal, every terminal-state probability, and terminal covariance, including when \(a_i=0\). No real-weight law is identified with a rational flow unless its arc occupations are rational.
statements.justification: This theorem separates the real convex object needed for exact minimax from the rational object needed for finite output while preserving the causal risk moments.
statements.gap: RaoZhang2025DDM optimizes over laws, and Haus2015Mixability uses fixed-row dynamic programming, but neither states the real and rational unequal-marginal covariance images as separate prefix-flow equivalences.
statements.consumer: The minimax theorem uses the compact real polytope, while the implementation theorem returns a rational point of its dense rational subset.

statements.statement: Over \(\mathcal F_{\mathbb R}(A,p)\), \(\mathrm{OPT}=\min_f\max_{H\succeq0,\operatorname{tr}(H)=1}\operatorname{tr}(HC(f))=\max_{H\succeq0,\operatorname{tr}(H)=1}\min_f\operatorname{tr}(HC(f))\), and both extrema are attained. Every optimum has a \(\mathsf{Cert}_{\mathrm{alg}}\), including at a tied largest eigenvalue, and a supplied such certificate is exactly verifiable in time polynomial in \(N_{\mathrm{lat}}\) and its joint algebraic representation length. For every \(b\), a \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\) implies \(L\le\mathrm{OPT}\le\lambda_{\max}(C(f))\le U\) and \(U-L\le2^{-b}\). Rational dyadic certificates approximate the value of an algebraic exact certificate but are not asserted to be coordinatewise truncations of it; an irrational exact optimum need not admit a rational zero-gap certificate.
statements.justification: The theorem makes the lower witness complete at eigenvalue ties and prevents algebraic exactness from being conflated with rational approximation.
statements.gap: AltschulerBoixAdsera2023StructuredMOT gives a linear-cost transport dual, while RaoZhang2025DDM uses spectral scalarization without a local exact Bellman certificate or the algebraic-versus-rational distinction.
statements.consumer: Independent checkers can validate either a supplied exact algebraic optimum or the rational additive output produced by the algorithm.

statements.statement: For fixed \(r\), \(\mathsf{PrefixCert}\) returns \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\) and an explicit rational finite-support assignment law inducing its flow in time polynomial in \(N_{\mathrm{lat}}\), the binary input length, and \(b\). Its optimization space has \(n+d+1\) dual coordinates; each assignment-separation call is a backward prefix recurrence using \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}})\) rational comparisons and arithmetic operations; and the emitted certificate has \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}}+n+d)\) rational entries of polynomial bit length. The proof must establish the dual box, primal and dual inner radii using \(a_0\) and \(M\), rational positive-semidefinite separation, a polynomial bound on oracle calls and truncation bits, exact recovery of every flow equality and prescribed marginal from the recorded paths, residual-to-feasibility repair, finite path decomposition of the recovered flow, and the final \(U-L\le2^{-b}\) inequality. On the common normalized fixed-row input class, Rao--Zhang Theorem 4.2 supplies an accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee for laws that already satisfy \(\Pr_D(z_i=1)=p_i\). By additionally returning an explicit rational finite-support law and representation, a locally checkable lower certificate, and an additive \(2^{-b}\) interval around the instance optimum, this theorem strictly strengthens the output and certification contract. It makes no numerical ordering claim between its upper endpoint and the Rao--Zhang benchmark bound.
statements.justification: The sole field-level novelty claim is the combinatorial Bellman separation and exact rational finite-support recovery theorem with a locally checkable two-sided certificate whose size is linear in the expanded lattice.
statements.gap: RaoZhang2025DDM, Theorem 4.2 and Eq. (6) on proceedings p. 1490, are used only for their accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee on laws already satisfying the prescribed marginals. They do not supply the explicit rational finite-support representation, additive instance-optimal lower interval, or local Bellman witness targeted here; no multiplier or numerical dominance relation is asserted pending an archived canonical primary-PDF verification.
statements.consumer: Low-dimensional unequal-allocation trials obtain an explicit finite-support sampler and a deterministic instance-specific risk interval at logarithmic accuracy.

statements.statement: Can the output-sensitive prefix-certificate handle produce a valid \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\) while visiting only the states certified relevant by its frontier bounds, with running time polynomial in the explored subgraph, input length, and \(b\), and with a worst-case guarantee no larger than the full \(N_{\mathrm{lat}}\)-state algorithm?
statements.justification: Reachable lattices can be much larger than the states relevant to the active spectral directions, so exact frontier pruning is the genuine remaining algorithmic question.
statements.gap: Haus2015Mixability enumerates the fixed-row lattice, and AltschulerBoixAdsera2023StructuredMOT assumes an exact pricing oracle; neither gives certified state pruning for a changing positive-semidefinite spectral cost.
statements.consumer: The benchmark grid can include instances whose full reachable lattice exceeds the prespecified state cap while retaining exact certificates.

statements.statement: Every feasible marginal-and-covariance pair has a representing law supported on at most \(n+k(B)+1\) assignments. Every optimal covariance has an optimal representing law supported on at most \(\min\{n+k(B)+1,n+r(r+1)/2\}\) assignments. From a rational feasible flow, respectively a supplied jointly algebraic optimal flow, affine-dependence elimination computes such a law while preserving \(\mathbb E[X]=p\) and the full covariance exactly.
statements.justification: Sparse exact support turns a certificate into a transparent implementable randomization law.
statements.gap: AltschulerBoixAdsera2023StructuredMOT, Lemma 2.1, counts marginal constraints for linear transport, while HarmanEtAl2024OptimalDesignPolytope studies information-matrix support; the result here integrates exact unequal marginals, the attainable feature rank, and recovery from an implicit prefix flow.
statements.consumer: Trial implementers can sample exactly from a short atom list and archive the complete design.

statements.statement: The construction \(D_{\mathrm{rep}}\) satisfies \(q^{\mathrm{rep}}\in[0,1]^n\), \(\mathbb E_{D_{\mathrm{rep}}}[X]=p\), and \(D_{\mathrm{rep}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathbb Q}(p)\). Its covariance about the target mean is \((1-\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}})\mathbb E_{\widehat D}[B(z-m)(z-m)^{\mathsf T}B^{\mathsf T}]+4\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}B\{\operatorname{diag}(q_i^{\mathrm{rep}}(1-q_i^{\mathrm{rep}}))+(q^{\mathrm{rep}}-p)(q^{\mathrm{rep}}-p)^{\mathsf T}\}B^{\mathsf T}\).
statements.justification: Empirical outputs become a feasible rational design, and the mean-shift term prevents a false covariance certificate.
statements.gap: RaoZhang2025DDM requires exact target marginals for its population assignment law, but it does not postprocess a finite empirical output law to those marginals with this covariance identity.
statements.consumer: The benchmark can certify the law it actually releases rather than an unknown sampler distribution.

statements.statement: For \(n=2\), \(p=(1/4,1/3)\), and \(B=\tfrac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}\), every feasible law is indexed by \(q=\Pr_D(X_1=X_2=1)\in[0,1/4]\), with \(\operatorname{Cov}_D(z)=\begin{pmatrix}3/4&4q-1/3\\4q-1/3&8/9\end{pmatrix}\) and \(C_D=C_{\mathrm{wit}}(q)=\begin{pmatrix}35/144+2q&5/36+q\\5/36+q&2/9\end{pmatrix}\). The map \(q\mapsto\lambda_{\max}(C_{\mathrm{wit}}(q))\) is strictly increasing on \([0,1/4]\), so \(q=0\) uniquely minimizes and \(\mathrm{OPT}=(67+\sqrt{1609})/288\). A rank-one trace-one positive-semidefinite witness and Bellman prices yield \(\mathsf{Cert}_{\mathrm{alg}}\), whereas every \(\mathsf{Cert}_b\) has positive width.
statements.justification: The explicit monotonic covariance path validates the boundary case and forces the exact algebraic and rational dyadic interfaces to remain distinct.
statements.gap: Neither RaoZhang2025DDM nor the linear structured-transport result exhibits this rational unequal-margin instance with an irrational spectral optimum and a complete local lower certificate.
statements.consumer: The first pilot cell detects routines that mistake a floating eigenvalue for an exact rational certificate.

statements.statement: When \(p_i=1/2\) for every \(i\) and all but the first row of \(B\) are zero, \(\mathrm{OPT}=\min_{z\in\{-1,1\}^n}(\sum_{i=1}^nB_{1i}z_i)^2\), attained by the symmetric law on a minimizing assignment and its negative. Thus zero optimum contains \(\mathsf{PARTITION}\), consistent with magnitude-sensitive fixed-row pseudopolynomial complexity.
statements.justification: The reduction is the required standard-case sanity check and explains the expanded-lattice complexity measure.
statements.gap: Haus2015Mixability establishes the neighboring mixability hardness and fixed-row pseudopolynomial regime; this statement specializes that boundary to the present design objective.
statements.consumer: Complexity reviewers can distinguish the claimed expanded-lattice algorithm from an unrestricted input-bit-only exact algorithm.

sampling_model.design: Finite-population randomization under a chosen law \(D\in\mathfrak D_{\mathbb R}(p)\); assignment is the only randomness.
sampling_model.units: The \(n\) units, balance matrix \(B\), and potential outcomes \(Y_i(0),Y_i(1)\) are fixed.
sampling_model.treatment: Binary assignment \(X_i=(z_i+1)/2\) with prescribed rational probability \(p_i\); coordinates with \(p_i\in\{0,1\}\) are deleted before optimization and restored deterministically.
sampling_model.overlap: No global overlap constant is imposed; bit complexity uses the encoded product mass \(a_0\) after deterministic-coordinate preprocessing.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None; the proposal chooses and certifies a randomization law rather than estimating a superpopulation nuisance.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Problem 3.1 restricts feasible laws by \(\Pr_D(z_i=1)=p_i\), Eq. (3) gives the covariance/MSE identity, and Theorem 4.2 with Eq. (6) on p. 1490 supplies an accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee with polynomial-time computation.

Theorem 4.1 establishes the polynomial equivalence of \(\mathsf{MOT}\), \(\mathsf{ELLIPSOID}\), and \(\mathsf{MIN}\); Theorem 4.3 states that Algorithm 1 returns an optimal sparse vertex using polynomially many \(\mathsf{ARGMIN}\) calls.
For a fixed number of rows, complete mixability and its bottleneck assignment objective are solvable in pseudopolynomial time.
The 2021 exact symbolic-homotopy algorithm solves rational semidefinite programs in polynomial arithmetic complexity when either the number of scalar variables or the matrix size is fixed.
The Gram--Schmidt walk controls spectral covariance and worst-case Horvitz--Thompson risk over a linear outcome class.

tldr: For prescribed unequal treatment probabilities, the headline result is a fixed-row prefix-lattice algorithm that emits an explicit rational finite-support design together with a positive-semidefinite, Bellman-verifiable additive instance-optimal interval of width \(2^{-b}\). Separate real and rational flow representations support exact minimax and finite rational output without conflating the two. The algorithm separates in \((H,\alpha,\beta)\)-space by an \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}})\) backward lattice recurrence, recovers an exact rational flow from the oracle transcript, and repairs feasibility in exact arithmetic; a distinct joint algebraic certificate covers exact irrational optima. Rao--Zhang's feasible laws already impose prescribed population marginals and their Eq. (3) already supplies the Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE bridge. The strict delta is the rational finite-support representation paired with a locally checkable lower certificate and a two-sided additive instance-optimal interval. Zero-row padding is only a definitional implementation observation for an auditable benchmark.

project_justification.gap: Unequal-margin DDM already optimizes over laws with the prescribed probabilities and supplies an accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee, but it supplies neither an additive instance-optimal lower interval nor an explicit rational finite-support representation paired with a locally checkable certificate; generic exact SDP results do not supply the pathwise certificate.
project_justification.niche: A fixed row dimension makes the reachable vector-prefix lattice pseudopolynomial even though the assignment law has exponentially many atoms and the spectral objective is nonsmooth.
project_justification.fill: The field-level contribution is PrefixCert: a real minimax representation coupled to rational Bellman separation, transcript-based primal recovery, exact residual repair, and finite path decomposition that emits the law and its two-sided additive certificate. Sparse compression, the known Horvitz--Thompson bridge, and zero-row padding are supporting components rather than novelty claims.

related_work: RaoZhang2025DDM is the closest experimental-design comparator. Its Problem 3.1 already restricts feasible assignment laws by \(\Pr_D(z_i=1)=p_i\), and its Eq. (3) already gives the Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE identity. Theorem 4.2 with Eq. (6) on proceedings p. 1490 is used only for an accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee under the common normalization; no explicit multiplier or numerical ordering is asserted pending an archived canonical primary-PDF verification. The fixed-row theorem claims no marginal-feasibility or covariance/MSE novelty. Its strict delta is an explicit rational finite-support law and flow representation delivered together with a locally checkable Bellman lower certificate and an additive interval around the instance optimum. The condition \(\mu=B^{\mathsf T}\theta\), \(\|\theta\|_2\le1\), is this proposal's restrictive low-dimensional consumer domain, with rows of \(B\) representing prespecified rationalized trial features such as an intercept, scaled baseline covariates, or externally trained prognostic scores; it is not attributed to Rao--Zhang and is outside the design-optimization headline. AltschulerBoixAdsera2023StructuredMOT, Theorem 4.1, proves the polynomial equivalence of \(\mathsf{MOT}\), \(\mathsf{ELLIPSOID}\), and \(\mathsf{MIN}\). Its Theorem 4.3 proves that Algorithm 1 returns an optimal sparse vertex using polynomially many \(\mathsf{ARGMIN}\) calls. These results supply the scalarized structured-transport and sparse-recovery architecture; they are method sources rather than theorem-level extension claims because the transport objective is one fixed linear cost. Haus2015Mixability supplies the fixed-row magnitude-sensitive lattice precedent and the neighboring \(\mathsf{PARTITION}\) boundary. HenrionNaldiSafeyElDin2021 proves exact symbolic SDP algorithms, including polynomial arithmetic complexity when the matrix size or scalar-variable count is fixed, but the growing flow block means it neither yields the claimed compact prefix-path certificate nor an input-polynomial exact design law; it is used only to delimit generic exact SDP machinery. HarshawSavjeSpielmanZhang2024GSW informs the proposal-maintained low-dimensional causal consumer class. HarmanEtAl2024OptimalDesignPolytope informs support reduction, so the support count is not positioned as a standalone novelty. ChatterjeeDeyGoswami2025GSWCLT and LiDingRubin2018Rerandomization show why spectral control alone does not yield a design-based limit law, which remains outside scope. ArbourDimmeryMaiRao2022Online concerns a distinct sequential problem.
technical_internal_limitation: The combinatorial complexity theorem must instantiate every enumerated proof obligation: the rational dual box and inner radii, exact positive-semidefinite separation, oracle-call and truncation-bit bounds, transcript-to-primal recovery, exact affine equalities, residual repair, and polynomial-size flow-to-law path decomposition. No projected covariance-hull description is assumed, and no generic polynomial exact algebraic construction is claimed. The four-cell benchmark is specified but unexecuted; no speed or variance superiority is asserted.
honest_scope: The real and rational flow images, minimax equality, certificate soundness and completeness, PrefixCert's fixed-row Bellman separation, exact rational finite-support recovery, and sparse support are theorem targets. Field-level novelty is claimed only for PrefixCert's combinatorial separation, recovery, and locally checkable two-sided additive certificate. The Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE identity is a known Rao--Zhang Eq. (3) consumer bridge specialized to this proposal's explicit low-dimensional outcome domain, and zero-row spectral invariance is a definitional implementation observation; neither is a theorem contribution. The output-sensitive state-pruning question is open and carries a concrete bidirectional-search handle. Unrestricted exact construction, projected-hull verification, growing-row identity robustness, fixed treatment counts, entropy constraints, superpopulation inference, generic central limit theory, and empirical performance claims are excluded. The equal-probability one-row reduction must coincide with the scalar \(\mathsf{PARTITION}\) boundary.

literature_map: Rao and Zhang's Problem 3.1 is the law-valued unequal-margin spectral objective and already imposes \(\Pr_D(z_i=1)=p_i\); their Eq. (3) already gives the Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE bridge. Their Theorem 4.2 with Eq. (6) in the PMLR proceedings on p. 1490 is used only as an accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee under the common normalization. No explicit multiplier or numerical ordering is asserted pending an archived canonical primary-PDF verification. The strict comparison is an explicit rational finite-support law and representation paired with a locally checkable lower certificate and additive instance-optimal interval. Altschuler and Boix-Adsera give the closest fixed-linear-cost transport oracle and sparse-recovery results: Theorem 4.1 establishes the polynomial equivalence of \(\mathsf{MOT}\), \(\mathsf{ELLIPSOID}\), and \(\mathsf{MIN}\), while Theorem 4.3 proves that Algorithm 1 returns an optimal sparse vertex using polynomially many \(\mathsf{ARGMIN}\) calls. The first changed step is the explicit positive-semidefinite assignment-dual separation by a labeled prefix recurrence, followed by transcript-to-flow rational finite-support recovery and exact repair. Haus supplies the fixed-row pseudopolynomial and \(\mathsf{PARTITION}\) precedent. Henrion, Naldi, and Safey El Din's primary 2021 Journal of Symbolic Computation article, pp. 942--959, gives a symbolic homotopy algorithm for degenerate rational spectrahedra and polynomial arithmetic complexity if the scalar-variable count or matrix size is fixed. That theorem does not collapse the growing flow nonnegativity block or emit a Bellman path certificate, so generic conditional-hull exact SDP material is not a proposal theorem. Harshaw and coauthors inform the proposal-maintained low-dimensional consumer condition \(\mu=B^{\mathsf T}\theta\), \(\|\theta\|_2\le1\), over prespecified trial-balance features; this condition is not attributed to Rao--Zhang. Harman and coauthors inform moment-preserving support reduction. Design-specific asymptotic papers remain outside the finite-population certification claim.

novelty_justification: The nearest experimental-design theorem is RaoZhang2025DDM, Theorem 4.2 with Eq. (6), used here only for its accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee under the common normalization. No explicit multiplier or numerical ordering is asserted pending an archived canonical primary-PDF verification. Rao--Zhang's Problem 3.1 already imposes \(\Pr_D(z_i=1)=p_i\), and their Eq. (3) already gives the Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE identity, so neither exact population marginals nor that identity is a delta. The nearest transport results are AltschulerBoixAdsera2023StructuredMOT, Theorem 4.1, which proves the polynomial equivalence of \(\mathsf{MOT}\), \(\mathsf{ELLIPSOID}\), and \(\mathsf{MIN}\), and Theorem 4.3, which proves that Algorithm 1 returns an optimal sparse vertex using polynomially many \(\mathsf{ARGMIN}\) calls. The sole field-level novelty claim is the specialized PrefixCert theorem: optimize only \(n+d+1\) assignment-dual coordinates, separate every exponential assignment constraint by an \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}})\) Bellman recurrence, recover an explicit rational finite-support law and flow from the oracle transcript, repair rational positive-semidefinite residuals, and emit an \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}}+n+d)\)-entry locally checkable lower certificate paired with an additive interval around the actual instance optimum. This strictly strengthens the available output and certification contract on the fixed-row lattice class without claiming numerical dominance of its upper endpoint. The sparse-support bound, empirical marginal repair, known Horvitz--Thompson bridge, and zero-row padding observation are supporting components rather than standalone novelty claims. The restrictive condition \(\mu=B^{\mathsf T}\theta\), \(\|\theta\|_2\le1\), is maintained only as a low-dimensional causal consumer over prespecified rationalized trial features and is not attributed to Rao--Zhang or included in the design-optimization headline. HenrionNaldiSafeyElDin2021 is explicitly not used to claim generic exact construction: its fixed-size exact SDP theorem does not provide the growing path-flow witness or the claimed certificate size. The first changed proof step and all remaining obligations are enumerated in the rank-one seed and Theorem 3.
